hero.title: MusicClipStudio
hero.subtitle: Transform music into amazing music videos with AI
hero.description: A powerful standalone tool for creating music clips. The first step brings your own music into the process. Support the development of this innovative project.

feature1.title: AI-Powered Auto Generation
feature1.description: Transform music into automatic visuals using advanced artificial intelligence

feature2.title: Free Media Database
feature2.description: Integrated database with free photos and videos from Pexels, Pixabay, and Unsplash

feature3.title: Original AI Soundtracks
feature3.description: Soundtracks generated by AI with original lyrics and melodies, narration-free

feature4.title: Intuitive Interface
feature4.description: Complete GUI with 5 simple steps: Music → Audio → Images → Media → Generate

feature5.title: Project for the Future
feature5.description: Audio and image engine that will be provided free to the community. Future planning: lipsync and everything in one place.

support.title: Support the Project
support.subtitle: Help turn this idea into reality
support.description: MusicClipStudio is in active development. Your financial support will be used to improve hardware and accelerate the development of the audio and image engine, which will be provided free to the community.
